name: pulsemon-browser
description: Browser SDK for Pulsemon: session replay (rrweb), click and scroll heatmap events, rage/dead clicks and errors, private by default.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --outdir dist --format esm --target browser --external @rrweb/record && bun build src/iife.ts --outfile dist/pulsemon-browser.iife.js --format iife --target browser --minify && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
